purpose: Necessary-condition screening of controller-only temperature sensitivity; not training, calibration fitting, SRA reproduction, or novelty proof.
selection_reason: Preselected front-weak final fixed epoch as the first named weak arm; no comparison or selection across models, epochs, or seeds in this check.
allowed_rows: 589 previously consumed development photos; validate each ID and label against existing fit-manifest. No reserved confirmation access.
method: For stored logits z and label y, use SRA equation MIS=(cos(softmax(z/T),onehot(y)))^(epsilon/log(C)), epsilon=2, C=37. Compare T=0.5,1,2. Temperatures perturb only the hypothetical controller; no labels, parameters, loss, or predictions are changed.
matching: Match the exact T=1 magnitude multiset by assigning its sorted values in the ranking induced by each temperature. Use source-ID tie breaks; rank in stable log space to avoid saturation ties.
required_checks: direct cosine formula versus sqrt(softmax(2*z/T)[y]) identity

engineering_gate.meaning: Only permission-to-invest scientific recommendation for a subsequent CPU paired-image diagnostic. Not significance, independent replication, training benefit, calibration quality, or originality. Secondary contrast cannot rescue a main-contrast failure.
